recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not reintroduce Device.operationalStatus or Device.operation for this issue; any future reconsideration should be handled as a new Device/DeviceAssociation design issue because later published decisions superseded the original R5 element path.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO issue for R5 asking why Device.operationalStatus.value was optional and resolving to make operationStatus.value 1..1 because the backbone is optional but a reason without a status does not make sense.
initial_application: Commit a984eb224be520d3bc43c5f369a5aaaf7ede1fe6 applied FHIR-32569 by changing source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so Device.operationalStatus.value had min=1 instead of min=0.
additional_context: Later Published Device issues reworked and then superseded the element shape: FHIR-36195 revised operationalStatus into operationalState/operation-style content, FHIR-37545 renamed operationalState to operation, and FHIR-38904 removed the Device operation/operationStatus backbone from active Device. Device and DeviceAssociation remain active resources in source/fhir.ini; current Device source contains the old operation/status/statusReason block only in an XML comment, while DeviceAssociation notes its operation backbone was collapsed into other elements.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build has no active Device.operationalStatus.value element with an incorrect cardinality; the only remaining commented Device.operation.status text already shows min=1 and is not build-scope behavior.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 issue that reworked Device.operationalStatus into the later operationalState/operation structure while preserving a required status child.
Published R5 issue/commit that renamed Device.operationalState to Device.operation in the same source family.
Published R5 issue that removed Device.operationStatus/operation from active Device and moved related association/operation concerns into DeviceAssociation and guidance.
